passage.label: patient decision Lord Muhammad not like companion fish called distressed; favor Lord overtook thrown naked shore censured; Lord chose made righteous; indeed disbelieve almost make slip eyes hear message say indeed mad; not except reminder worlds

arabicExcerpts.text: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومٞ
لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومٞ
وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ

mainSubject.label: Patience commanded for the Lord's decision, warning against resembling the companion of the fish who called out in distress and would have been cast onto the naked shore censured had divine favour not overtaken him, after which his Lord chose him and made him righteous; disbelievers nearly making the Prophet slip with their eyes upon hearing the message, calling him mad, while it is nothing but a reminder to the worlds

propheticNarratives.label: Companion of the fish calling out in distress, saved by divine favour, chosen and made righteous

relationships.label: The Quran named nothing but a reminder to the worlds against charges of madness

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the snout-branding verdict (16) before the garden-companions parable opens (17); P2 ends with the worldly-versus-hereafter punishment comparison (33) before the righteous-gardens and rhetorical challenges begin (34); P3 runs through the criminal-equation challenge, the shin-uncovering scene and the progressive-leading declaration (34-47); P4 covers Yunus's patience lesson, the evil-eye threat and the closing reminder-to-the-worlds declaration (48-52).
